title: GLEAN: Grounded Lightweight Evaluation Anchors for Contamination-Aware Tabular Reasoning
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures for the main paper
summary: Tabular reasoning benchmarks mix semantic inference, numerical computation, and brittle table formatting, yet evaluations for small models remain vulnerable to contamination, dataset artifacts, and retrieval failures. We propose GLEAN, a lightweight evaluation protocol that integrates contamination-aware probes, weak-supervision governance, retrieval-reasoning diagnostics, and structured error attribution under tight hardware constraints. We evaluate across TabFact, WTQ via Squall, TableBench, RobuT, and SciTab under a 16GB GPU budget. Using Squall gold SQL as an executable anchor (95.2% execution), GLEAN assigns a deterministic error taxonomy (L0-L4 plus L0.5 context miss) and reveals a stable error-mode separation: TAPEX errors skew toward grounding (L3) while TAPAS errors skew toward hallucination/abstention (L2/L0). We validate evidence-row heuristics against SQL-derived rows on simple queries (0.62 precision / 0.71 recall; hybrid recall 0.81) and show that retrieval Recall@K can saturate even when end-to-end EM/F1 remains limited, motivating attribution beyond raw recall. We release a modular framework with audits and sensitivity checks to make small-model tabular evaluation more contamination-aware and diagnostic.

AI.tldr: GLEAN是一个轻量级表格推理评估协议，通过污染感知探针、弱监督治理、检索-推理诊断和结构化错误归因，在16GB GPU预算下评估小型模型在表格推理任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 当前表格推理基准测试存在语义推理、数值计算和脆弱的表格格式混合问题，且小型模型的评估容易受到数据污染、数据集伪影和检索失败的影响。
AI.method: 提出GLEAN评估协议，整合以下四个核心组件：1)污染感知探针(contamination-aware probes)；2)弱监督治理(weak-supervision governance)；3)检索-推理诊断(retrieval-reasoning diagnostics)；4)结构化错误归因(structured error attribution)。使用Squall gold SQL作为可执行锚点(95.2%执行率)，建立确定性错误分类体系(L0-L4及L0.5上下文缺失)。
AI.result: 1)验证了TAPEX错误偏向于接地问题(L3)，而TAPAS错误偏向于幻觉/弃权(L2/L0)，呈现稳定的错误模式分离；2)证据行启发式方法达到0.62精确率/0.71召回率，混合召回率达0.81；3)发现检索Recall@K可能饱和而端到端EM/F1仍然受限，这推动了对原始召回率之外进行归因的必要性。评估数据集包括TabFact、WTQ(via Squall)、TableBench、RobuT和SciTab。
AI.conclusion: GLEAN作为一个模块化框架，通过审计和敏感性检查，使小型模型的表格推理评估更加污染感知化和诊断化，为表格推理评估提供了新的方法论。

title: HELIOS: Harmonizing Early Fusion, Late Fusion, and LLM Reasoning for Multi-Granular Table-Text Retrieval
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at ACL 2025 main. Project page: https://helios-projectpage.github.io/
summary: Table-text retrieval aims to retrieve relevant tables and text to support open-domain question answering. Existing studies use either early or late fusion, but face limitations. Early fusion pre-aligns a table row with its associated passages, forming "stars," which often include irrelevant contexts and miss query-dependent relationships. Late fusion retrieves individual nodes, dynamically aligning them, but it risks missing relevant contexts. Both approaches also struggle with advanced reasoning tasks, such as column-wise aggregation and multi-hop reasoning. To address these issues, we propose HELIOS, which combines the strengths of both approaches. First, the edge-based bipartite subgraph retrieval identifies finer-grained edges between table segments and passages, effectively avoiding the inclusion of irrelevant contexts. Then, the query-relevant node expansion identifies the most promising nodes, dynamically retrieving relevant edges to grow the bipartite subgraph, minimizing the risk of missing important contexts. Lastly, the star-based LLM refinement performs logical inference at the star graph level rather than the bipartite subgraph, supporting advanced reasoning tasks. Experimental results show that HELIOS outperforms state-of-the-art models with a significant improvement up to 42.6\% and 39.9\% in recall and nDCG, respectively, on the OTT-QA benchmark.

AI.tldr: HELIOS是一种结合早融合和晚融合优点的表-文本检索方法，通过边-based二分子图检索、查询相关节点扩展和基于星的LLM精炼三个阶段，在OTT-QA基准上实现了显著的性能提升（召回率提升42.6%，nDCG提升39.9%）。
AI.motivation: 现有研究使用早融合或晚融合方法，但存在局限性：早融合预先对齐表行与段落形成"星形"结构，常包含无关上下文且丢失查询相关关系；晚融合动态对齐单个节点，但可能遗漏相关上下文；两者在列聚合和多跳推理等高级推理任务上表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出HELIOS方法，包含三个阶段：（1）边-based二分子图检索：识别表片段与段落之间的细粒度边，有效避免无关上下文；（2）查询相关节点扩展：识别最有希望的节点，动态检索相关边以扩展二分子图，最小化遗漏重要上下文的风险；（3）基于星的LLM精炼：在星图级别而非二分子图级别进行逻辑推理，支持高级推理任务。
AI.result: 在OTT-QA基准上，HELIOS优于现有最优模型，召回率提升高达42.6%，nDCG提升高达39.9%。
AI.conclusion: HELIOS成功结合了早融合和晚融合的优点，通过细粒度边检索、动态节点扩展和星图级推理，有效解决了表-文本检索中的上下文相关性和高级推理问题。

title: Cross-Layer Decision Timing Orchestration in Cost-Based Database Systems: Resolving Structural Temporal Misalignment
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures. Experimental evaluation on a modified PostgreSQL prototype
summary:
This paper analyzes execution instability in traditional cost-based database management systems (DBMS) and identifies a structural timing misalignment between optimization and execution stages that contributes to tail-latency amplification. Beyond estimation accuracy and raw execution throughput, we argue that decision timing and the availability of runtime signals materially affect robustness under uncertainty.
  In conventional DBMS architectures, the optimizer relies on historical statistics, the executor observes runtime data distributions and resource states, and accelerators impose up-front transfer costs and amortization constraints. This temporal asynchrony can lead to rigid early-bound decisions that fail under input-scale shifts or stale statistics.
  We propose a cross-layer decision timing orchestration framework that shifts final decision authority from the compile-time optimizer to the runtime executor via selective late binding of operator-level choices. A Unified Risk Signal (URS) integrates optimizer uncertainty, execution-time observations, and accelerator cost signals without collapsing them into a single static cost model.
  Experiments on a modified PostgreSQL prototype evaluate (i) input-scale shift, (ii) stale-statistics drift, and (iii) GPU offload break-even regimes using controlled microbenchmarks. The proposed orchestration improves execution stability, reducing P99 latency by up to 20x under severe estimation drift while maintaining comparable median latency.

AI.tldr: This paper addresses execution instability in traditional cost-based DBMS caused by timing misalignment between optimization and execution stages. The authors propose a cross-layer decision timing orchestration framework with a Unified Risk Signal (URS) that shifts decision authority from compile-time optimizer to runtime executor via selective late binding. Experiments on modified PostgreSQL show up to 20x P99 latency reduction under severe estimation drift.
AI.motivation: Traditional cost-based DBMS suffer from execution instability and tail-latency amplification due to a structural timing misalignment between optimization and execution stages. The optimizer relies on historical statistics while the executor observes runtime data distributions, and accelerators impose up-front transfer costs. This temporal asynchrony leads to rigid early-bound decisions that fail under input-scale shifts or stale statistics. The paper argues that decision timing and the availability of runtime signals materially affect robustness under uncertainty, beyond just estimation accuracy and raw execution throughput.
AI.method: The paper proposes a cross-layer decision timing orchestration framework that shifts final decision authority from the compile-time optimizer to the runtime executor via selective late binding of operator-level choices. A Unified Risk Signal (URS) is introduced to integrate optimizer uncertainty, execution-time observations, and accelerator cost signals without collapsing them into a single static cost model. Experiments are conducted on a modified PostgreSQL prototype using controlled microbenchmarks.
AI.result: Experiments on a modified PostgreSQL prototype evaluated three scenarios: (i) input-scale shift, (ii) stale-statistics drift, and (iii) GPU offload break-even regimes. The proposed orchestration improves execution stability, reducing P99 latency by up to 20x under severe estimation drift while maintaining comparable median latency.
AI.conclusion: The proposed cross-layer decision timing orchestration framework successfully improves execution stability, reducing P99 latency by up to 20x under severe estimation drift while maintaining comparable median latency. This is achieved through selective late binding of operator-level choices, moving final decision authority from compile-time optimizer to runtime executor.

title: Large Language Model-Enhanced Relational Operators: Taxonomy, Benchmark, and Analysis
summary: With the development of large language models (LLMs), numerous studies integrate LLMs through operator-like components to enhance relational data processing tasks, e.g., filters with semantic predicates, knowledge-augmented table imputation, reasoning-driven entity matching and more challenging semantic query processing. These components invoke LLMs while preserving a relational input/output interface, which we refer to as LLM-Enhanced Relational Operators (LROs). From an operator perspective, unfortunately, these existing LROs suffer from fragmented definition, various implementation strategies and inadequate evaluation benchmarks. To this end, in this paper, we first establish a unified LRO taxonomy to align existing LROs, and categorize them into: Select, Match, Impute, Cluster and Order, along with their operands and implementation variants. Second, we design LROBench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring 290 single-LRO queries and 60 multi-LRO queries, spanning 27 databases across more than 10 domains. LROBench covers all operating logics and operand granularities in its single-LRO workload, and provides challenging multi-LRO queries stratified by query complexity. Based on these, we evaluate individual LROs under various implementations, deriving practical insights into LRO design choices and summarizing our empirical best practices. We further compare the end-to-end performance of existing multi-LRO systems against an LRO suite instantiated with these best practices, in order to investigate how to design an effective LRO set for multi-LRO systems targeting complex semantic queries. Last, to facilitate future work, we outline promising future directions and open-source all benchmark data and evaluation code, available at https://github.com/LROBench/LROBench/.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型增强的关系运算符(LRO)进行了系统研究，建立了统一分类体系，设计了包含350个查询的综合基准LROBench，并通过实验获得了LRO设计的最佳实践经验，为复杂语义查询处理提供了有效指导。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型(LLM)的发展，许多研究将LLM集成到关系数据处理任务中，但现有LRO存在定义碎片化、实现策略多样化以及评估基准不足等问题，亟需系统性的研究和评估框架。
AI.method: 首先建立了统一的LRO分类体系，将现有LRO分为Select、Match、Impute、Cluster和Order五类；其次设计了LROBench基准测试，包含290个单LRO查询和60个多LRO查询，涵盖27个数据库和10多个领域；在多种实现下评估了各个LRO，并从中提炼出实践经验；最后对比了现有多LRO系统与基于最佳实践构建的LRO套件的性能差异。
AI.result: 建立了统一的LRO分类体系；设计了全面的LROBench基准测试；获得了关于LRO设计选择的实践经验；证明了基于最佳实践的LRO套件在处理复杂语义查询方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究开源了LROBench基准数据集和评估代码，为后续研究提供了重要资源。并展望了有前景的未来研究方向，为LRO领域的进一步发展奠定了基础。

title: RxnNano:Training Compact LLMs for Chemical Reaction and Retrosynthesis Prediction via Hierarchical Curriculum Learning
summary: Chemical reaction prediction is pivotal for accelerating drug discovery and synthesis planning. Despite advances in data-driven models, current approaches are hindered by an overemphasis on parameter and dataset scaling. Some methods coupled with evaluation techniques that bypass fundamental challenges in reaction representation and fail to capture deep chemical intuition like reaction common sense and {topological atom mapping logic}. We argue that the core challenge lies in instilling these knowledge into the models. To this end, we propose a unified framework that prioritizes chemical understanding over scale through three key innovations: (1) a {Latent Chemical Consistency} objective that models reactions as movements on a continuous chemical manifold, ensuring reversible and physically plausible transformations; (2) a {Hierarchical Cognitive Curriculum} that trains the model through progressive stages, from syntax mastery to semantic reasoning, building robust chemical intuition; (3) {Atom-Map Permutation Invariance (AMPI)}, which force the model to learn invariant relational topology and balance multi-task learning. (4)and structured plan-based reasoning to improve the performance of the LLMs. Our compact {0.5B-parameter model}, \textbf{RxnNano} significantly outperforms fine-tuned LLMs ten times larger (>7B) and all the domain baselines, achieving a 23.5\% Top-1 accuracy improvement on rigorous benchmarks without test-time augmentation. https://github.com/rlisml/RxnNano.

AI.tldr: RxnNano是一个0.5B参数的化学反应预测模型，通过三个关键创新（潜在化学一致性目标、层次认知课程学习和原子图排列不变性）来解决化学反应的表示学习问题，无需大规模参数和数据集即可超越10倍以上的大型语言模型。
AI.motivation: 当前数据驱动的化学反应预测模型过度依赖参数和数据集规模的扩展，忽视了反应表示和化学直觉（如反应常识和拓扑原子映射逻辑）这些根本性挑战。核心问题在于如何将这些化学知识融入模型中。
AI.method: 提出统一框架包含四个创新点：(1)潜在化学一致性(Latent Chemical Consistency)目标，将反应建模为连续化学流形上的运动，确保可逆和物理上合理的转化；(2)层次认知课程(Hierarchical Cognitive Curriculum)训练，从句法掌握到语义推理的渐进阶段；(3)原子图排列不变性(AMPI)，强制模型学习不变的关系拓扑并平衡多任务学习；(4)结构化计划推理以提升LLM性能。
AI.result: RxnNano在严格基准测试中实现了23.5%的Top-1准确率提升，无需测试时增强即可显著优于微调的大型语言模型（>7B参数）和所有领域基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，在化学反应预测任务中，优先考虑化学理解而非模型规模是更有效的策略。紧凑的0.5B参数模型通过融入化学直觉知识可以超越十倍以上的大型模型。

title: CUCo: An Agentic Framework for Compute and Communication Co-design
summary: Custom CUDA kernel development is essential for maximizing GPU utilization in large-scale distributed LLM training and inference, yet manually writing kernels that jointly leverage both computation and communication remains a labor-intensive and error-prone process. Prior work on kernel optimization has focused almost exclusively on computation, leaving communication kernels largely untouched even though they constitute a significant share of total execution time. We introduce CUCo, a training-free agent-driven workflow that automatically generates high-performance CUDA kernels that jointly orchestrate computation and communication. By co-optimizing these traditionally disjoint components, CUCo unlocks new optimization opportunities unavailable to existing approaches, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines and reducing end-to-end latency by up to $1.57\times$.

AI.tldr: CUCo是一个无需训练的智能体驱动工作流，可自动生成高性能CUDA内核，实现计算与通信的联合优化。
AI.motivation: 手动编写同时利用计算和通信的CUDA内核既费时又容易出错，且此前内核优化工作几乎只关注计算部分，通信内核虽占用大量执行时间却被忽视。
AI.method: 提出CUCo，一个训练-free的智能体驱动工作流，自动生成高性能CUDA内核，对传统上分离的计算和通信进行联合优化。
AI.result: 超越最先进基线方法，端到端延迟降低最高达1.57倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合优化计算与通信，可解锁现有方法无法实现的新优化机会。

title: The Alignment Flywheel: A Governance-Centric Hybrid MAS for Architecture-Agnostic Safety
summary: Multi-agent systems provide mature methodologies for role decomposition, coordination, and normative governance, capabilities that remain essential as increasingly powerful autonomous decision components are embedded within agent-based systems. While learned and generative models substantially expand system capability, their safety behavior is often entangled with training, making it opaque, difficult to audit, and costly to update after deployment. This paper formalizes the Alignment Flywheel as a governance-centric hybrid MAS architecture that decouples decision generation from safety governance. A Proposer, representing any autonomous decision component, generates candidate trajectories, while a Safety Oracle returns raw safety signals through a stable interface. An enforcement layer applies explicit risk policy at runtime, and a governance MAS supervises the Oracle through auditing, uncertainty-driven verification, and versioned refinement. The central engineering principle is patch locality: many newly observed safety failures can be mitigated by updating the governed oracle artifact and its release pipeline rather than retracting or retraining the underlying decision component. The architecture is implementation-agnostic with respect to both the Proposer and the Safety Oracle, and specifies the roles, artifacts, protocols, and release semantics needed for runtime gating, audit intake, signed patching, and staged rollout across distributed deployments. The result is a hybrid MAS engineering framework for integrating highly capable but fallible autonomous systems under explicit, version-controlled, and auditable oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Alignment Flywheel架构，通过将决策生成与安全治理解耦，利用多智能体系统实现对强大学主但易错的人工智能组件的可审计、可更新的安全治理。
AI.motivation: 随着日益强大的自主决策组件被嵌入基于智能体的系统，现有的安全行为往往与训练过程纠缠在一起，导致不透明、难以审计且部署后更新成本高昂的问题，需要一种可治理的混合多智能体系统架构。
AI.method: 设计了一种治理中心的混合MAS架构，包含四个核心组件：1) Proposer（提议者）：代表自主决策组件生成候选轨迹；2) Safety Oracle（安全预言机）：通过稳定接口返回原始安全信号；3. Enforcement layer（执行层）：在运行时应用显式风险策略；4) Governance MAS（治理智能体）：通过审计、不确定性驱动的验证和版本化 refinement 对Oracle进行监督。核心工程原则是"patch locality"（补丁局部性）。
AI.result: 该架构与Proposer和Safety Oracle的实现无关，指定了运行时门控、审计接收、签名补丁和分布式部署分阶段发布所需的角色、制品、协议和发布语义。
AI.conclusion: 为将高能力但易错的自主系统集成到显式、版本控制和可审计的监督之下提供了一种混合MAS工程框架。

title: RIVA: Leveraging LLM Agents for Reliable Configuration Drift Detection
summary: Infrastructure as code (IaC) tools automate cloud provisioning but verifying that deployed systems remain consistent with the IaC specifications remains challenging. Such configuration drift occurs because of bugs in the IaC specification, manual changes, or system updates. Large language model (LLM)-based agentic AI systems can automate the analysis of large volumes of telemetry data, making them suitable for the detection of configuration drift. However, existing agentic systems implicitly assume that the tools they invoke always return correct outputs, making them vulnerable to erroneous tool responses. Since agents cannot distinguish whether an anomalous tool output reflects a real infrastructure problem or a broken tool, such errors may cause missed drift or false alarms, reducing reliability precisely when it is most needed. We introduce RIVA (Robust Infrastructure by Verification Agents), a novel multi-agent system that performs robust IaC verification even when tools produce incorrect or misleading outputs. RIVA employs two specialized agents, a verifier agent and a tool generation agent, that collaborate through iterative cross-validation, multi-perspective verification, and tool call history tracking. Evaluation on the AIOpsLab benchmark demonstrates that RIVA, in the presence of erroneous tool responses, recovers task accuracy from 27.3% when using a baseline ReAct agent to 50.0% on average. RIVA also improves task accuracy 28% to 43.8% without erroneous tool responses. Our results show that cross-validation of diverse tool calls enables more reliable autonomous infrastructure verification in production cloud environments.

AI.tldr: RIVA（Robust Infrastructure by Verification Agents）是一个多智能体架构，用于在工具调用可能返回错误/误导性输出的情况下，可靠地验证基础设施即代码（IaC）规范与实际部署环境之间是否存在配置漂移。其核心思想是：同一目标的两次独立工具调用同时出错的概率很低，因此通过"验证者代理（Verifier Agent）+ 工具生成代理（Tool Generation Agent）+ 共享工具调用历史（Tool Call History）"对每一条 IaC 属性做多路径交叉验证，用结果之间的矛盾来区分"真实漂移"与"工具故障"。在 AIOpsLab 基准上，含错误工具响应时平均任务成功率从 ReAct 基线的 27.3% 提升至 50.0%；工具全部正确时从 28% 提升至 43.8%，同时步数与 token 消耗显著更低。
AI.motivation: IaC 工具（Terraform、Ansible、CloudFormation 等）虽被广泛用于声明式地定义与交付基础设施，但部署后的实际环境常常偏离规范定义，即产生配置漂移（configuration drift）：既可能源于 IaC 模块/Provider API 的隐性缺陷（如实例被创建却未绑定预期安全组，而 Terraform 仍报告成功），也可能源于运维人员绕过 IaC 的手工热修复、自动扩缩容或系统更新。检测漂移需要持续关联海量的日志、指标、链路与状态变更，人工成本高且易漏判。LLM 智能体因擅长模式识别、跨源信息关联与自然语言推理，被证明适合自动化此类验证工作。但现有智能体架构隐含假设"所调用工具总是返回正确输出"：真实环境中工具会因 API 宕机、限流、网络抖动、解析错误、Provider 实现过期而返回不完整、陈旧或矛盾的信息。更棘手的是，这类"静默错误"（工具成功执行但返回错误结果）在表征上与真实配置漂移高度相似（同样表现为字段缺失、状态异常、信息互相冲突），智能体无法区分二者，从而造成漏报漂移或误报故障。这种缺陷恰好在基础设施最需要可靠性的时刻削弱了系统的可靠性。因此本文的核心研究问题是：如何设计即便在工具返回错误或误导性输出时，仍能稳健验证 IaC 定义的基础设施的智能体系统？
AI.method: 论文提出 RIVA 多智能体系统并集成进微软 AIOpsLab 基准。架构包含两个协作的 LLM 代理与一个共享数据结构：(1) Tool Call History——以"属性标识符（IaC 规范中的具体行）"为键、以最多 K 条执行记录为值的映射，每条记录必须使用互不相同的工具，条目内容包含执行的命令及参数、工具返回结果、以及对该结果含义的简要分析；(2) Tool Generation Agent——先查阅该属性的历史记录以避免重复，随后合成一条采用不同技术/不同视角的新验证命令，执行之，若调用有误（参数错误、语法错误）则自行纠正后重试，成功后写入 Tool History；(3) Verifier Agent——持有 IaC 规范，按属性查询历史：若无可用条目则请求工具生成代理生成命令，若已有条目则分析既有结果是否足以支撑结论；关键约束是只有当积累到 K 条来自不同诊断路径的记录时才给出结论，从而抑制过早下结论，同时其推理步与工具生成交替进行，允许动态重规划、放弃非必要属性（被放弃属性因 K 约束不会被判定为已证伪/已证实）。方法论上的关键洞见是"工具通常是复杂命令的包装器"——例如 get_logs 失效时可直接通过 SSH 读取 Pod 日志文件，因此多个异构诊断路径同时出错的概率很低；通过比较输出、发现矛盾并迭代精炼验证尝试即可区分真实漂移与工具异常。实验：将 AIOpsLab 的 get_logs、read_traces、read_metrics 配置为返回空字符串以模拟"静默错误"（接口违规/执行失败仍按预期抛异常）；对比 AIOpsLab 内置 ReAct 基线，覆盖 detection、localization、analysis 三类任务，分别注入 get_logs 或 read_metrics 的错误行为，每任务运行 5 次，模型统一为 gpt-oss:120b，两系统最大步数均设为 45（对 RIVA 为双代理合计步数）。此外还分析步数/token 效率分布，并做超参 K=1/2/3 的敏感性分析。
AI.result: 任务成功率：在存在错误工具响应时，RIVA（K=2）的平均成功率从 ReAct 的 27.3% 恢复到 50.0%；在工具全部正确的条件下，平均成功率从 28.0% 提升到 43.75%/43.8%。分任务看，含错误工具时 RIVA 的成功率恒不低于"工具正确的 ReAct"：例如 localization 任务 ReAct 在正确工具下 22.2%、get_logs 出错时跌至 11.1%，而 RIVA 在同样错误工具下达到 20.0%；detection 任务 ReAct 正确工具 50.0%、错误 get_logs 时反而升至 62.5%（因空日志促使其更聚焦指标、减少幻觉）。K 的影响呈倒 U 型：K=1 时 RIVA 与 ReAct 基本持平（27.67/24.80/29.02），K=2 最优（43.75/46.67/53.33），K=3 直接归零（0/0/0），原因是 AIOpsLab 提供的诊断路径不足，工具生成代理无法为同一属性构造出第三条不同命令而空转至步数上限（77% 的运行触及 45 步，83% 的运行 token<15000）。效率：正确工具下 RIVA 80% 的任务在 15 步内完成（ReAct 60%），RIVA 步数峰值 17 步而 33% 的 ReAct 运行触及 45 步上限；峰值 token 为 RIVA 38,000 对 ReAct 78,000。含错误工具时 RIVA 仍最多 17 步（37% 的 ReAct 任务超此步数），峰值 token 50,000 对 90,000。局限：RIVA 未能完全抵消错误工具的影响，localization 在全正确工具下为 40.0%，而 get_logs 与 read_metrics 均错误时降至 20.0%；轨迹分析显示瓶颈在工具生成代理——它为纠正自身错误（如找错服务名）而做的探索性调用不会写入 Tool Call History，后续请求需重复同样的发现工作，增加步数与出错概率。论文将其列为可改进点（动态把探索性调用追加进历史），并指出被放弃的属性因 K 约束不会被结论使用。
AI.conclusion: 通过让多个异构工具调用针对同一 IaC 属性做交叉验证与迭代验证，RIVA 能够在工具"静默失败"时把真实配置漂移与工具故障区分开，从而显著提升自主基础设施验证的可靠性：有错工具时把平均任务成功率从 27.3% 拉回 50.0%，无错工具时从 28% 提升到 43.8%，且以更少的步数与 token 完成（峰值 38k vs 78k；错误工具下 50k vs 90k）。与相关工作相比，RIVA 的差异在于其不依赖显式异常信号（PALADIN、AgentDebug 类方法）、也不依赖模型内部"怀疑工具"的先验（Tools Fail）或策略级形式化验证（VeriGuard），而是提供结构化的、位于智能体之外的工具输出可靠性验证机制。作者同时坦承其能力受限于 AIOpsLab 的诊断路径多样性，并明确指出性能对超参 K 高度敏感。后续工作方向有三：(1) 改进工具生成行为，使代理在生成过程中用到的多个工具调用能动态写入历史，避免重复发现；(2) 细化 K 相关的系统行为，在找不到 K 条备选路径时以降低置信度的方式继续分析而非直接失败；(3) AIOpsLab 对全面评估 RIVA 过于受限，需要开发或采用更贴近真实 IaC 部署场景、可直接访问部署环境并提供更宽诊断路径的新基准，以在生产级设定下更充分地验证 RIVA 的交叉验证能力。

title: Federated Inference: Toward Privacy-Preserving Collaborative and Incentivized Model Serving
summary: Federated Inference (FI) studies how independently trained and privately owned models can collaborate at inference time without sharing data or model parameters. While recent work has explored secure and distributed inference from disparate perspectives, a unified abstraction and system-level understanding of FI remain lacking. This paper positions FI as a distinct collaborative paradigm, complementary to federated learning, and identifies two fundamental requirements that govern its feasibility: inference-time privacy preservation and meaningful performance gains through collaboration. We formalize FI as a protected collaborative computation, analyze its core design dimensions, and examine the structural trade-offs that arise when privacy constraints, non-IID data, and limited observability are jointly imposed at inference time. Through a concrete instantiation and empirical analysis, we highlight recurring friction points in privacy-preserving inference, ensemble-based collaboration, and incentive alignment. Our findings suggest that FI exhibits system-level behaviors that cannot be directly inherited from training-time federation or classical ensemble methods. Overall, this work provides a unifying perspective on FI and outlines open challenges that must be addressed to enable practical, scalable, and privacy-preserving collaborative inference systems.

AI.tldr: 本文将联邦推理(FI)定位为一种与联邦学习互补的协作推理范式，定义了推理时隐私保护和有意义性能提升两个基本要求，将FI形式化为受保护的协作计算，分析了其核心设计维度与结构化权衡，并通过具体实例和实证分析揭示了隐私保护推理、基于集成的协作和激励对齐中的摩擦点。
AI.motivation: 当前研究虽已从不同角度探索安全和分布式推理，但缺乏对FI的统一抽象和系统级理解，需要将FI确立为一个独立的协作范式
AI.method: 将FI形式化为受保护的协作计算，分析核心设计维度，在联合约束、非IID数据和有限可观测性下研究结构化权衡，并通过具体实例和实证分析验证
AI.result: FI表现出无法直接从训练时联邦学习或经典集成方法继承的系统级行为，揭示了隐私保护推理、集成协作和激励对齐中的 recurring friction points
AI.conclusion: FI是一个独特的协作范式，需要新的系统设计方法，为构建实用、可扩展且隐私保护的协作推理系统指明了开放性挑战

title: Timehash: Hierarchical Time Indexing for Efficient Business Hours Search
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to VLDB 2026 Industry Track
summary:
Temporal range filtering is a critical operation in large-scale search systems, particularly for location-based services that need to filter businesses by operating hours. Traditional approaches either suffer from poor query performance (scope filtering) or index size explosion (minute-level indexing).
  We present Timehash, a novel hierarchical time indexing algorithm that achieves over 99% reduction in index size compared to minute-level indexing while maintaining 100% precision. Timehash employs a flexible multi-resolution strategy with customizable hierarchical levels. Through empirical analysis on distributions from 12.6 million business records of a production location search service, we demonstrate a data-driven methodology for selecting optimal hierarchies tailored to specific data distributions.
  We evaluated Timehash on up to 12.6 million synthetic POIs generated from production distributions. Experimental results show that a five-level hierarchy reduces index terms to 5.6 per document (99.1% reduction versus minute-level indexing), with zero false positives and zero false negatives. Scalability benchmarks confirm constant per-document cost from 100K to 12.6M POIs, while supporting complex scenarios such as break times and irregular schedules. Our approach is generalizable to various temporal filtering problems in search systems, e-commerce, and reservation platforms.

AI.tldr: Timehash是一种新型层次化时间索引算法，在位置搜索服务中实现超过99%的索引大小缩减，同时保持100%精度。该方法使用灵活的多分辨率策略，通过数据驱动方式选择最优层级，实验表明五级层级将每文档索引词减少至5.6个，零误报，从100K到12.6M POIs保持常数成本。
AI.motivation: 传统方法存在缺陷：范围过滤查询性能差，而分钟级索引导致索引大小爆炸。位置服务需要按营业时间过滤商家，因此需要一种高效的时间范围过滤方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Timehash的新型层次化时间索引算法，采用灵活的多分辨率策略和可定制的层级结构。通过对12.6 million条生产环境业务记录分布的实证分析，展示了针对特定数据分布选择最优层级的数据驱动方法。
AI.result: 五级层级将每文档索引词减少到5.6个（比分钟级索引减少99.1%），零假阳性和零假阴性。扩展性测试确认从100K到12.6M POIs的常数每文档成本，同时支持休息时间和不规则营业时间等复杂场景。
AI.conclusion: Timehash提供了一种实用的时间过滤解决方案，在保持100%精度的同时实现了显著的索引大小缩减。该方法可广泛应用于搜索系统、电子商务和预订平台中的各种时间过滤问题。

title: ATPO: Adaptive Tree Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Medical Dialogue
summary: Effective information seeking in multi-turn medical dialogues is critical for accurate diagnosis, especially when dealing with incomplete information. Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) for these interactive scenarios is challenging due to the uncertainty inherent in user-agent interactions, which we formulate as a Hierarchical Markov Decision Process (H-MDP). While conventional Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) struggle with long-horizon credit assignment and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) suffers from unstable value estimation in this context, we propose a novel uncertainty-aware Adaptive Tree Policy Optimization (ATPO) algorithm. Our method adaptively allocates the rollout budget to states with high uncertainty, quantified by a composite metric of Bellman error and action-value variance. This strategy enables more accurate value estimation, while fostering more efficient and diverse exploration. To mitigate the high computational cost of tree-based RL, we introduce two key optimizations: an uncertainty-guided pruning mechanism to minimize the number of rollouts, and an asynchronous search architecture that leverages KV cache reuse to maximize inference throughput. Extensive experiments on three public medical dialogue benchmarks demonstrate that our algorithm significantly outperforms several strong baselines, culminating in Qwen3-8B model surpassing the much larger GPT-4o ($+0.92\%$ accuracy).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对多轮医学对话的 uncertainty-aware Adaptive Tree Policy Optimization (ATPO) 算法，通过不确定性引导的自适应 rollout 分配和树搜索优化，在医学对话任务上使 Qwen3-8B 超越 GPT-4o 0.92%。
AI.motivation: 医学对话中的信息获取任务具有高度不确定性，传统强化学习方法（如 GRPO 和 PPO）在长时序信用分配和价值估计方面存在困难，需要一种能够处理交互不确定性的新方法。
AI.method: 将医学对话建模为 Hierarchical Markov Decision Process (H-MDP)，提出 ATPO 算法：1) 使用 Bellman 误差和动作价值方差的复合指标量化不确定性；2) 自适应分配 rollout 预算到高不确定性状态；3) 引入不确定性引导的剪枝机制减少 rollout 数量；4) 采用异步搜索架构通过 KV cache 重用提升推理吞吐量。
AI.result: 在三个公开医学对话基准数据集上的实验表明，ATPO 显著优于多个强基线方法，Qwen3-8B 模型超越更大的 GPT-4o 模型（+0.92% 准确率）。
AI.conclusion: 通过不确定性感知的自适应树策略优化和高效的计算架构设计，可以有效解决医学对话中的长时序信用分配和价值估计不稳定问题，实现小模型超越大模型的效果。

title: Why Atomicity Matters to AI/ML Infrastructure: Snapshots, Firmware Updates, and the Cost of the Forward-In-Time-Only Category Mistake
summary:
Large-scale AI/ML training systems depend on two assumptions that are rarely examined: (1) that checkpoints represent atomic snapshots of global training state, and (2) that infrastructure updates can be applied without inducing mixed-protocol cluster states. Both assumptions are instances of a deeper structural error: the Forward-In-Time-Only (FITO) category mistake, which confuses protocol convergence properties with temporal predicates.
  We formalize this confusion as a type error: the identification of a temporal snapshot $\mathsf{Snap}(t)$ with a convergence property $\mathsf{Conv}(\mathcal{P},e)$. We model checkpoint execution in a process-algebraic framework and prove that under asynchronous composition with crash-recovery failures, no temporal instant can serve as an atomicity boundary. We reformulate checkpoint inconsistency on an epoch lattice and show that atomicity is a measure-zero event whose complement grows exponentially with the number of independent persistence domains. We formalize mixed-epoch recovery as a type violation in the optimization algebra and show that the resulting update is not a valid step of any standard optimizer.
  For firmware fleet updates, we strengthen the known consensus-hardness result: atomic deployment requires not merely agreement but common knowledge of the epoch transition, which is strictly unattainable in asynchronous systems with unreliable communication.
  We conclude by sketching a bilateral convergence protocol, inspired by Open Atomic Ethernet, that achieves $\mathsf{Conv}(\mathcal{P},e)$ without requiring $\mathsf{Snap}(t)$ -- replacing the FITO assumption with constraint semantics.

AI.tldr: 论文识别并形式化了AI/ML训练系统中的FITO范畴错误，证明检查点原子性在异步故障条件下不可达，并提出无需原子快照的收敛协议解决方案。
AI.motivation: Large-scale AI/ML训练系统依赖两个很少被审视的假设：(1)检查点代表全局训练状态的原子快照，(2)基础设施更新可以在不引起混合协议集群状态的情况下应用。作者指出这两个假设是更深层结构错误的表现，即"正向时间唯一"(FITO)范畴错误，混淆了协议收敛属性与时间谓词。
AI.method: 作者采用过程代数框架对检查点执行进行形式化建模，在异步组合与崩溃恢复故障条件下进行数学证明。将检查点不一致性问题在epoch格上重新表述，证明原子性是零测度事件，其补集随独立持久域数量呈指数增长。将混合epoch恢复形式化为优化代数中的类型违规。
AI.result: 证明在异步组合与崩溃恢复故障条件下，任何时间点都不能作为原子性边界。原子性是零测度事件，其补集随独立持久域数量指数增长。原子部署不仅需要共识，还需要epoch转换的共同知识，这在异步系统中不可达。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种受Open Atomic Ethernet启发的双边收敛协议，该协议可在不要求Snap(t)的情况下实现Conv(P,e)，用约束语义替代FITO假设。

title: StitchCUDA: An Automated Multi-Agents End-to-End GPU Programing Framework with Rubric-based Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Modern machine learning (ML) workloads increasingly rely on GPUs, yet achieving high end-to-end performance remains challenging due to dependencies on both GPU kernel efficiency and host-side settings. Although LLM-based methods show promise on automated GPU kernel generation, prior works mainly focus on single-kernel optimization and do not extend to end-to-end programs, hindering practical deployment.
  To address the challenge, in this work, we propose StitchCUDA, a multi-agent framework for end-to-end GPU program generation, with three specialized agents: a Planner to orchestrate whole system design, a Coder dedicated to implementing it step-by-step, and a Verifier for correctness check and performance profiling using Nsys/NCU. To fundamentally improve the Coder's ability in end-to-end GPU programming, StitchCUDA integrates rubric-based agentic reinforcement learning over two atomic skills, task-to-code generation and feedback-driven code optimization, with combined rubric reward and rule-based reward from real executions. Therefore, the Coder learns how to implement advanced CUDA programming techniques (e.g., custom kernel fusion, cublas epilogue), and we also effectively prevent Coder's reward hacking (e.g., just copy PyTorch code or hardcoding output) during benchmarking. Experiments on KernelBench show that StitchCUDA achieves nearly 100% success rate on end-to-end GPU programming tasks, with 1.72x better speedup over the multi-agent baseline and 2.73x than the RL model baselines.

AI.tldr: StitchCUDA是一个端到端GPU程序生成的多Agent框架，通过Planner、Coder、Verifier三个专业Agent协作，结合基于规则的正则化强化学习，在KernelBench上达到近100%成功率，显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现代ML工作负载依赖GPU，但实现端到端高性能仍具挑战；现有LLM方法主要关注单内核优化，未扩展到端到端程序，阻碍实际部署。
AI.method: 提出StitchCUDA多Agent框架，包含Planner、Coder、Verifier三个专业Agent；集成基于规则的正则化强化学习，聚焦任务到代码生成和反馈驱动代码优化两个原子技能，结合规则奖励和基于真实执行的 rubric 奖励。
AI.result: 在KernelBench上实现近100%端到端GPU编程任务成功率；比多Agent基线提升1.72x加速比；比RL模型基线提升2.73x加速比。
AI.conclusion: StitchCUDA通过多Agent协作和基于规则的正则化强化学习，成功实现了端到端GPU程序的高效生成，在KernelBench上达到近100%成功率，分别比多Agent基线和RL模型基线提升1.72x和2.73x加速比。

title: Fuzzing Microservices in Face of Intrinsic Uncertainties
summary: The widespread adoption of microservices has fundamentally transformed how modern software systems are designed, deployed, operated and maintained. However, well-known microservice properties (e.g., dynamic scalability and decentralized control) introduce inherent and multi-dimensional uncertainties. These uncertainties span across inter-service interactions, runtime environments, and internal service logic, which manifest as nondeterministic behaviors, performance fluctuations, and unpredictable fault propagation. Existing approaches do not have sufficient support in capturing such uncertainties and their propagation in industrial microservice systems, and these approaches mostly focus on single-service testing. In this paper, we argue for a novel paradigm: ``uncertainty-driven'' and ``system-level'' microservice testing. We outline key research challenges, including the modeling and injection of uncertainties and their propagation, causal inference for fault localization, and multi-dimensional analyses and assessment of uncertainties and their impact on system quality. We propose an architecture for continuous uncertainty-driven and system-level microservice fuzzing, which integrates service virtualization, uncertainty simulation, adaptive test generation and optimization\revision{, and illustrate it with an e-commerce example we developed}. Our goal is to inspire the development of scalable and automated system-level testing methods that improve the dependability and resilience of industrial microservice systems, with the explicit consideration of uncertainties and their propagation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的微服务测试范式：不确定性驱动和系统级测试。现有的微服务测试方法无法有效捕获和传播不确定性，且主要关注单服务测试。文章提出了一种连续不确定性驱动的系统级模糊测试架构，集成了服务虚拟化、不确定性模拟、自适应测试生成和优化，旨在提高工业微服务系统的可靠性和弹性。
AI.motivation: 微服务的固有特性（如动态可扩展性和去中心化控制）引入了多维度的不确定性，这些不确定性跨越服务间交互、运行时环境和内部服务逻辑，表现为非确定性行为、性能波动和不可预测的故障传播。现有方法不足以捕获这些不确定性及其在工业微服务系统中的传播。
AI.method: 提出了一种连续不确定性驱动的系统级微服务模糊测试架构，集成四个核心组件：1) 服务虚拟化；2) 不确定性模拟；3) 自适应测试生成；4) 优化。使用电子商务示例进行说明。
AI.result: 本文主要贡献是提出了新的测试范式和架构框架，识别了三个关键研究挑战：不确定性的建模与注入、不确定性的传播、故障定位的因果推理，以及多维度分析与评估。
AI.conclusion: 该研究旨在启发开发可扩展的自动化系统级测试方法，明确考虑不确定性及其传播，以提高工业微服务系统的可靠性和弹性。

title: Engineering Reasoning and Instruction (ERI) Benchmark: A Large Taxonomy-driven Dataset for Foundation Models and Agents
summary: The Engineering Reasoning and Instruction (ERI) benchmark is a taxonomy-driven instruction dataset designed to train and evaluate engineering-capable large language models (LLMs) and agents. This dataset spans nine engineering fields (namely: civil, mechanical, electrical, chemical, environmental, aerospace, materials, fire, and industrial engineering) and 55 subdomains, and is crossed with seven intent types (i.e., definition, explanation, calculation, comparison, design/synthesis, troubleshooting, and code-related) and three difficulty tiers (undergraduate, graduate, and professional), yielding 57,750 records with field/subdomain/type/difficulty metadata and solution formatting. We examined ERI via seven LLMs and report a statistically significant three-tier performance structure, with frontier models (GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4, DeepSeek V3.1) achieving mean scores above 4.30 on a five-point scale, while mid-tier and smaller models exhibited progressively higher failure rates and steeper performance degradation on graduate-level questions. To address circularity concerns inherent in LLM benchmarks, we developed a convergent validation protocol that leverages cross-provider independence, multi-judge averaging, and frontier-model agreement analysis to empirically bound hallucination risk to 1.7%. ERI is released with taxonomy specifications, validation scripts, and an evaluation harness to enable reproducible comparisons and regression testing for instruction tuning, routing, retrieval-augmented evaluation, and agentic tool-use workflows in engineering settings.

AI.tldr: ERI基准是一个由分类学驱动的工程指令数据集，旨在训练和评估具备工程能力的大型语言模型(LLM)和智能体，涵盖9个工程领域、55个子领域、7种意图类型和3个难度层级，共57,750条记录。
AI.motivation: 解决工程领域LLM基准测试的两个核心挑战：(1)缺乏专门针对工程任务的指令数据集；(2)LLM基准测试中固有的循环性问题（训练数据污染导致评估结果不可靠）。
AI.method: 构建了跨9个工程领域、7种意图类型（定义、解释、计算、比较、设计/合成、故障排除、代码相关）和3个难度层级（本科、研究生、专业）的57,750条记录数据集；使用7个LLM进行评估；开发了交叉提供者独立性、多裁判平均和前沿模型协议分析的收敛验证协议来约束幻觉风险。
AI.result: 发现显著的三层性能结构：前沿模型（GPT-5、Claude Sonnet 4、DeepSeek V3.1）在5分制上平均得分超过4.30；中层和较小模型表现出更高的失败率和在研究生水平问题上的更陡峭性能下降；验证协议将幻觉风险经验性约束在1.7%。
AI.conclusion: ERI基准为工程领域的指令微调、路由、检索增强评估和智能体工具使用工作流提供了可复现的比较和回归测试基础，数据集包含分类学规范、验证脚本和评估工具包。

title: A Graph-Native Approach to Normalization
summary: In recent years, knowledge graphs (KGs) - in particular in the form of labeled property graphs (LPGs) - have become essential components in a broad range of applications. Although the absence of strict schemas for KGs facilitates structural issues that lead to redundancies and subsequently to inconsistencies and anomalies, the problem of KG quality has so far received only little attention. Inspired by normalization using functional dependencies for relational data, a first approach exploiting dependencies within nodes has been proposed. However, real-world KGs also expose functional dependencies involving edges. In this paper, we therefore propose graph-native normalization, which considers dependencies within nodes, edges, and their combination. We define a range of graph-native normal forms and graph object functional dependencies and propose algorithms for transforming graphs accordingly. We evaluate our contributions using a broad range of synthetic and native graph datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图原生规范化(graph-native normalization)方法，用于解决知识图谱中因缺乏严格模式导致的冗余、不一致和异常问题。该方法考虑了节点内、边及其组合的依赖关系，定义了图原生范式和图对象函数依赖，并提供了转换算法。实验在合成和原生图数据集上进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱(KGs)尤其是标记属性图(LPGs)在众多应用中成为重要组件。尽管KGs缺乏严格模式会导致结构问题，进而引发冗余、不一致和异常，但图谱质量问题至今未得到充分关注。现有研究仅利用节点内依赖性，而现实世界的KGs还存在涉及边的函数依赖。
AI.method: 提出图原生规范化方法，综合考虑节点内、边以及节点与边组合的依赖关系。定义了多种图原生范式和图对象函数依赖(Graph Object Functional Dependencies)，并设计了相应的图转换算法。
AI.result: 在多种合成和原生图数据集上验证了所提方法的有效性（具体数值结果摘要未详述）。
AI.conclusion: 图原生规范化能够有效处理知识图谱中的冗余、不一致和异常问题，为图数据的规范化理论奠定了基础。

title: Is Retraining-Free Enough? The Necessity of Router Calibration for Efficient MoE Compression
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity efficiently, but their massive parameter footprint creates a deployment-time memory bottleneck. We organize retraining-free MoE compression into three paradigms - Expert Pruning, Expert Editing, and Expert Merging - and show that persistent post-compression degradation largely stems from a neglected factor: router-expert mismatch when experts are changed but the router is left untouched. We argue that effective retraining-free compression should avoid updating expert parameters while allowing lightweight router calibration. To this end, we propose Router Knowledge Distillation (Router KD), which updates only a tiny fraction of parameters (the router) by distilling the original model's next-token distribution on unlabeled calibration data. Experiments across representative methods in all three paradigms demonstrate consistent performance recovery, with substantially larger gains in fine-grained MoEs (many small experts) than in coarse-grained MoEs due to their more complex routing decision boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文将免重训练MoE压缩分为三类范式（专家剪枝、专家编辑、专家合并），指出性能下降的主要原因是路由器与专家不匹配。提出Router KD方法，仅通过在未标注数据上提取原始模型分布来更新路由器参数，在三类压缩范式中均实现一致的性能恢复，细粒度MoE收益更大。
AI.motivation: MoE模型虽然能高效扩展容量，但大规模参数在部署时造成内存瓶颈。现有的免重训练MoE压缩方法存在严重的性能下降，问题根源在于：专家被改变但路由器未更新，导致路由器与专家之间的不匹配（router-expert mismatch）。
AI.method: 提出Router Knowledge Distillation (Router KD)方法：仅更新路由器参数（极小比例），通过在未标注校准数据上提取原始模型的next-token分布来训练路由器。
AI.result: 在三种压缩范式（专家剪枝、专家编辑、专家合并）的实验中均实现了一致的性能恢复。细粒度MoE（大量小专家）由于路由决策边界更复杂，获得的性能提升显著大于粗粒度MoE。
AI.conclusion: 有效的免重训练MoE压缩应在避免更新专家参数的同时，允许轻量级路由器校准。Router KD通过仅更新路由器参数（原始模型参数的一小部分），利用未标注校准数据提取原始模型的下一token分布，可在三种压缩范式下实现一致的性能恢复。

title: Undecided State Dynamics with Many Opinions
summary:
We study the Undecided-State Dynamics (USD), a fundamental consensus process in which each vertex holds one of $k$ decided opinions or the undecided state. We consider both the gossip model and the population protocol model. Prior work established tight bounds on the consensus time of this process only for the regime $k = O(\sqrt{n}/(\log n)^2)$ (for the population protocol model) and $k = O((n/\log n)^{1/3})$ (for the gossip model), often under restrictive assumptions on the initial configuration.
  In this paper, we obtain the first consensus-time guarantees for USD that hold for \emph{arbitrary} $2\le k\le n$ and for \emph{arbitrary} initial configurations in both the gossip model and the population protocol model. In the gossip model, USD reaches consensus within $\widetilde O(\min\{k,\sqrt n\})$ synchronous rounds with probability $1-p_{\bot}-n^{-c}$, where $p_{\bot}$ is the gossip-specific probability of collapsing to the all-undecided state in the first round. In the population protocol model, USD reaches consensus within $\widetilde O(\min\{kn,n^{3/2}\})$ asynchronous interactions with high probability. We also present lower bounds that match the upper bounds up to polylogarithmic factors for a specific initial configuration and show that our upper bounds are essentially optimal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Undecided-State Dynamics (USD)，这是一种基本的一致性过程，其中每个顶点持有k个已决定意见之一或未决定状态。作者在gossip模型和population protocol模型中获得了第一个对任意2≤k≤n和任意初始配置都成立的一致性时间保证。
AI.motivation: 先前的工作仅在限制性条件下建立了USD共识时间的紧边界：对于population protocol模型仅在k = O(√n/(log n)²)的情况下，对于gossip模型仅在k = O((n/log n)^{1/3})的情况下，且通常对初始配置有严格假设。因此，需要在任意k值和任意初始配置下获得一致性时间保证。
AI.method: 作者分析了USD在两种模型下的行为：gossip模型（同步轮次）和population protocol模型（异步交互）。
AI.result: 在gossip模型中，USD在~O(min{k, √n})同步轮次内达到一致性，概率为1-p_⊥-n^{-c}，其中p_⊥是gossip模型中第一轮塌缩到全未决定状态的概率。在population protocol模型中，USD在~O(min{k n, n^{3/2})异步交互内以高概率达到一致性。作者还展示了与上界在多对数因子范围内匹配的下界，并表明上界本质上是最佳的。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了USD分析中的关键空白，首次为任意k值和任意初始配置提供了一致性时间保证，并证明了这些上界在多对数因子范围内是最优的。

title: Generalized Per-Agent Advantage Estimation for Multi-Agent Policy Optimization
comment: Accepted at the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026)
summary: In this paper, we propose a novel framework for multi-agent reinforcement learning that enhances sample efficiency and coordination through accurate per-agent advantage estimation. The core of our approach is Generalized Per-Agent Advantage Estimator (GPAE), which employs a per-agent value iteration operator to compute precise per-agent advantages. This operator enables stable off-policy learning by indirectly estimating values via action probabilities, eliminating the need for direct Q-function estimation. To further refine estimation, we introduce a double-truncated importance sampling ratio scheme. This scheme improves credit assignment for off-policy trajectories by balancing sensitivity to the agent's own policy changes with robustness to non-stationarity from other agents. Experiments on benchmarks demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing approaches, excelling in coordination and sample efficiency for complex scenarios.

AI.tldr: 一种新型多智能体强化学习框架，利用广义per-agent优势估计器(GPAE)和双截断重要性采样，通过精确优势估计提升样本效率和协同能力。
AI.motivation: 旨在提升多智能体强化学习中的样本效率和协同能力，通过精确的per-agent优势估计来解决现有方法的问题。
AI.method: 提出广义per-agent优势估计器(GPAE)，采用per-agent价值迭代算子计算精确的per-agent优势，通过动作概率间接估计值以实现稳定的离策略学习；引入双截断重要性采样方案，平衡智能体自身策略变化的敏感性与对其他智能体非平稳性的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在基准测试上的实验表明，该方法在协同和复杂场景的样本效率方面优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的GPAE框架通过精确的per-agent优势估计和双截断重要性采样方案，有效提升了多智能体强化学习中的样本效率和协同能力，在复杂场景中表现优于现有方法。

title: His2Trans: A Skeleton First Framework for Self Evolving C to Rust Translation with Historical Retrieval
summary: Automated C-to-Rust migration encounters systemic obstacles when scaling from code snippets to industrial projects, mainly because build context is often unavailable ("dependency hell") and domain-specific evolutionary knowledge is missing. As a result, current LLM-based methods frequently cannot reconstruct precise type definitions under complex build systems or infer idiomatic API correspondences, which in turn leads to hallucinated dependencies and unproductive repair loops. To tackle these issues, we introduce His2Trans, a framework that combines a deterministic, build-aware skeleton with self-evolving knowledge extraction to support stable, incremental migration. On the structural side, His2Trans performs build tracing to create a compilable Project-Level Skeleton Graph, providing a strictly typed environment that separates global verification from local logic generation. On the cognitive side, it derives fine-grained API and code-fragment rules from historical migration traces and uses a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system to steer the LLM toward idiomatic interface reuse. Experiments on industrial OpenHarmony modules show that His2Trans reaches a 99.75% incremental compilation pass rate, effectively fixing build failures where baselines struggle. On general-purpose benchmarks, it lowers the unsafe code ratio by 23.6 percentage points compared to C2Rust while producing the fewest warnings. Finally, knowledge accumulation studies demonstrate the framework's evolutionary behavior: by continuously integrating verified patterns, His2Trans cuts repair overhead on unseen tasks by about 60%.

AI.tldr: His2Trans是一个用于大规模C到Rust自动迁移的框架，通过构建感知骨架图提供严格类型化环境，结合检索增强生成从历史迁移中提取知识，在工业项目中达到99.75%编译通过率，降低23.6%不安全代码，修复效率提升60%。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM驱动的C-to-Rust迁移方法在从代码片段扩展到工业级项目时面临系统性障碍，主要源于构建上下文缺失("依赖地狱")和领域特定演化知识缺失，导致无法精确重构复杂构建系统下的类型定义，无法推断惯用API对应关系，从而产生幻觉依赖和无效修复循环。
AI.method: His2Trans采用双层架构：(1)结构层面通过构建追踪创建可编译的项目级骨架图(PSG)，提供严格类型化环境，将全局验证与局部逻辑生成分离；(2)认知层面从历史迁移痕迹中提取细粒度API和代码片段规则，利用检索增强生成(RAG)系统引导LLM实现惯用接口复用。
AI.result: 在OpenHarmony工业模块上达到99.75%增量编译通过率，有效修复了基线方法难以解决的构建失败；在通用基准上比C2Rust降低23.6个百分点的不安全代码比例，产生最少警告；知识积累研究表明框架的进化行为使未见任务的修复开销降低约60%。
AI.conclusion: His2Trans通过结合确定性构建感知骨架与自演化知识提取，成功解决了大规模C到Rust迁移中的核心难题。实验表明该框架在工业级项目(OpenHarmony)中达到99.75%的增量编译通过率，在通用基准上比C2Rust降低23.6个百分点的不安全代码比例，并通过持续集成验证模式将未见任务的修复开销降低约60%，证明了其进化特性。

title: SuperLocalMemory: Privacy-Preserving Multi-Agent Memory with Bayesian Trust Defense Against Memory Poisoning
summary: We present SuperLocalMemory, a local-first memory system for multi-agent AI that defends against OWASP ASI06 memory poisoning through architectural isolation and Bayesian trust scoring, while personalizing retrieval through adaptive learning-to-rank -- all without cloud dependencies or LLM inference calls. As AI agents increasingly rely on persistent memory, cloud-based memory systems create centralized attack surfaces where poisoned memories propagate across sessions and users -- a threat demonstrated in documented attacks against production systems. Our architecture combines SQLite-backed storage with FTS5 full-text search, Leiden-based knowledge graph clustering, an event-driven coordination layer with per-agent provenance, and an adaptive re-ranking framework that learns user preferences through three-layer behavioral analysis (cross-project technology preferences, project context detection, and workflow pattern mining). Evaluation across seven benchmark dimensions demonstrates 10.6ms median search latency, zero concurrency errors under 10 simultaneous agents, trust separation (gap =0.90) with 72% trust degradation for sleeper attacks, and 104% improvement in NDCG@5 when adaptive re-ranking is enabled. Behavioral data is isolated in a separate database with GDPR Article 17 erasure support. SuperLocalMemory is open-source (MIT) and integrates with 17+ development tools via Model Context Protocol.

AI.tldr: SuperLocalMemory是一个本地优先的多智能体AI记忆系统，通过架构隔离和贝叶斯信任评分防御OWASP ASI06记忆 poisoning攻击，同时通过自适应学习排序实现个性化检索，无需云依赖或LLM推理调用。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体依赖持久记忆，云记忆系统产生集中攻击面，污染记忆可在会话和用户间传播——这已在生产系统攻击中得到证实。现有云记忆方案存在中心化风险。
AI.method: 架构：SQLite+FTS5全文搜索；Leiden知识图聚类；事件驱动协调层（每智能体可追溯）；自适应重排序框架（三层行为分析：跨项目技术偏好、项目上下文检测、工作流模式挖掘）。
AI.result: 基准测试结果：搜索延迟中位数10.6ms；10个并发智能体零错误；信任分离度0.90（sleeper攻击信任下降72%）；NDCG@5提升104%。
AI.conclusion: SuperLocalMemory通过本地化架构有效防御记忆投毒，支持GDPR第17条删除，整合17+开发工具（Model Context Protocol），MIT开源。

title: V3DB: Audit-on-Demand Zero-Knowledge Proofs for Verifiable Vector Search over Committed Snapshots
summary:
Dense retrieval services increasingly underpin semantic search, recommendation, and retrieval-augmented generation, yet clients typically receive only a top-$k$ list with no auditable evidence of how it was produced. We present V3DB, a verifiable, versioned vector-search service that enables audit-on-demand correctness checks for approximate nearest-neighbour (ANN) retrieval executed by a potentially untrusted service provider. V3DB commits to each corpus snapshot and standardises an IVF-PQ search pipeline into a fixed-shape, five-step query semantics. Given a public snapshot commitment and a query embedding, the service returns the top-$k$ payloads and, when challenged, produces a succinct zero-knowledge proof that the output is exactly the result of executing the published semantics on the committed snapshot -- without revealing the embedding corpus or private index contents. To make proving practical, V3DB avoids costly in-circuit sorting and random access by combining multiset equality/inclusion checks with lightweight boundary conditions. Our prototype implementation based on Plonky2 achieves up to $22\times$ faster proving and up to $40\%$ lower peak memory consumption than the circuit-only baseline, with millisecond-level verification time.
  Github Repo at https://github.com/TabibitoQZP/zk-IVF-PQ.

AI.tldr: V3DB是一个可验证的版本化向量搜索服务，通过零知识证明实现ANN检索结果的可审计性，基于Plonky2实现，比纯电路方案快22倍，内存降低40%。
AI.motivation: 密集检索服务（如语义搜索、推荐系统、RAG）通常只返回top-k结果，缺乏可审计的证据来验证结果正确性。用户无法验证返回结果是否真正由指定算法在承诺的语料库上执行产生。
AI.method: 将IVF-PQ搜索管道标准化为固定形状的五步查询语义；结合多重集相等/包含性检查与轻量级边界条件，避免代价高昂的电路内排序和随机访问；基于Plonky2零知识证明框架实现。
AI.result: 原型实现比纯电路基线快达22倍，峰值内存降低达40%，验证时间达到毫秒级。
AI.conclusion: V3DB首次实现了对近似最近邻检索的可验证性，支持按需审计，无需透露嵌入向量或私有索引内容，为不可信的向量搜索服务提供商提供了可验证性保障。

title: Self-Play Only Evolves When Self-Synthetic Pipeline Ensures Learnable Information Gain
summary: Large language models (LLMs) make it plausible to build systems that improve through self-evolving loops, but many existing proposals are better understood as self-play and often plateau quickly. A central failure mode is that the loop synthesises more data without increasing learnable information for the next iteration. Through experiments on a self-play coding task, we reveal that sustainable self-evolution requires a self-synthesised data pipeline with learnable information that increases across iterations. We identify triadic roles that self-evolving LLMs play: the Proposer, which generates tasks; the Solver, which attempts solutions; and the Verifier, which provides training signals, and we identify three system designs that jointly target learnable information gain from this triadic roles perspective. Asymmetric co-evolution closes a weak-to-strong-to-weak loop across roles. Capacity growth expands parameter and inference-time budgets to match rising learnable information. Proactive information seeking introduces external context and new task sources that prevent saturation. Together, these modules provide a measurable, system-level path from brittle self-play dynamics to sustained self-evolution.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了LLM自我演化系统的可持续性问题。通过自博弈编码任务实验，识别出Proposer、Solver、Verifier三元角色，并提出三种系统设计（不对称协同演化、能力增长、主动信息寻求）来解决传统自博弈易陷入 plateau 的问题，实现可学习信息的持续增长。
AI.motivation: 现有许多自博弈提案很快陷入 plateau，核心失败模式是循环合成更多数据但未增加下一次迭代的可学习信息，需要构建能够通过自我演化循环持续改进的系统。
AI.method: 通过在自博弈编码任务上的实验，识别出自我演化LLM的三元角色：生成任务的Proposer、尝试解决方案的Solver以及提供训练信号的Verifier，并从三元角色角度提出了三种系统设计：不对称协同演化、能力增长和主动信息寻求。
AI.result: 三种系统设计共同作用，提供了从脆弱的自博弈动态到持续自我演化的可测量系统级路径。
AI.conclusion: 提出的三元角色视角（Proposer、Solver、Verifier）和三种系统设计（不对称协同演化、能力增长、主动信息寻求）为从脆弱的自博弈动态到持续自我演化提供了可测量的系统级路径。

title: MuxTune: Efficient Multi-Task LLM Fine-Tuning in Multi-Tenant Datacenters via Spatial-Temporal Backbone Multiplexing
summary: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) is widely applied as the backend of fine-tuning APIs for large language model (LLM) customization in datacenters. Service providers deploy separate instances for individual PEFT tasks, giving rise to prominent resource inefficiencies, including (1) GPU underutilization from small-scale, PEFT-native operators and (2) device stalls from communication delays and data dependencies in parallelized execution. To address these issues, this paper presents MuxTune, a fine-tuning system that enables resource-efficient concurrent execution of multiple PEFT tasks. The key idea is to multiplex the backbone across independent tasks in a spatial-temporal manner for improved utilization and reduced stalls. Building on flexible, modularized backbone sharing via unified PEFT representations, MuxTune proposes hierarchical co-scheduling scheme with task, operator, and data-level optimizations. Specifically, it fuses tasks through a hybrid of spatial and temporal multiplexing, and orchestrates multi-task operator execution in two-tiered hybrid parallelism. Additionally, MuxTune employs chunk-based data alignment to mitigate inter-task ineffective tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that MuxTune achieves up to $2.33\times$ higher throughput and $5.29\times$ memory reduction compared to three state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: MuxTune 是面向多租户数据中心「LLM 微调 API 后端」的多任务 PEFT 并发执行系统。核心思想是**空间—时间骨干网复用（spatial-temporal backbone multiplexing）**：多个独立 PEFT 任务共享同一份冻结 backbone，空间上以批维拼接（spatial batching）提升算子利用率，时间上以流水线时钟交错（temporal interleaving）掩盖设备停顿。系统围绕「统一 PEFT 表示 + 层次化多任务协同调度」构建，包含三个模块（Model Generator / Execution Planner / PEFT Engine），并在任务级（hTask 抽象 + 装箱问题的 DP 求解）、算子级（两层混合并行的 inter/intra-stage 编排、适配器水平融合、NVLink SHARP 通信重叠）、数据级（基于 chunk 的序列对齐以抑制跨任务无效 token）三个层次联合优化。相较 HF-PEFT、NeMo Megatron、SLoRA-PEFT 三个基线，端到端吞吐最高提升 2.33×，显存占用最高降低 5.29×（H100 上对 NeMo 提升 5.29× 吞吐），128-GPU 集群回放下集群吞吐提升最高 1.61×。
AI.motivation: PEFT 是 LLM 微调 API 的主流后端，服务商却为每个 PEFT 任务单独部署实例（各自持有一份 backbone 副本与实例），造成两类显著资源低效：(1) **GPU 利用率不足**——PEFT 省略了计算密集的 backbone 权重梯度计算，且引入小规模算子（LoRA down-projection 秩 ≤64，相比 LLaMA7B hidden=4096 小 64×，单算子延迟 0.46ms vs 预训练 1.80ms，SM 占用差距达 40.9%），这些小算子挂在不连续的 qkv-proj 等位置又无法直接竖向/横向融合；叠加 PEFT 语料序列更短（可达 64）、batch 更小，单卡 MFU 相对预训练下降最高 1.47×，且在高端硬件上更严重（V100/A40/RTX6000 上 PEFT 平均 MFU 仅为预训练的 0.84×/0.68×/0.59×）。(2) **设备停顿**——adapter 拉长阶段延迟与 stage 内通信量，多卡下 MFU 额外下降 1.65×；PEFT 因缺少权重梯度无法直接复用 DualPipe/ZB-H2 的无气泡流水（由省略权重梯度造成的停顿随 micro-batch 数线性增长、无法摊销，直接套用 DualPipe 反而使吞吐降 1.16×），而通信重叠类技术（切小 tile 以重叠通信）在本身已低利用率的 PEFT 中适得其反（利用率再降 24.5%，GPT2.7B 双卡延迟升 1.17×）。同时 GPU 算力增长速度远超互联带宽（H100+NVLink 到 A40+PCIe4.0 的 MFU 差距 3.18×），使上述问题进一步恶化。作者进一步指出三种「直观复用」方案均不足：MPS/多流粗粒度共置受显存约束（4×A40 仅能共置 8 任务）、缺乏算子级控制导致任务间干扰（文献报告 2.5× 性能下降）；多 LoRA 服务式的批处理空间复用在 PEFT 中会放大流水线停顿、引入无效计算（批处理在 compute-bound 的 PEFT 中收益递减）、且仍需 padding；纯时间复用/重叠牺牲算子内利用率，在小输入下更不可行。因此必须做空间—时间的统一层次化设计，而非单点复用。
AI.method:
**1) 统一 PEFT 表示与模块化 backbone 共享**：将 PEFT 抽象为四个子模块——BaseOp（可挂载 adapter 的 backbone 算子）、Adapter（用户定制的 PEFT 算法）、Dispatch（多任务数据分发规则）、Aggregate（输出聚合规则）。与 HF-PEFT/NeMo 的「静态嵌套注入」不同，MuxTune 采用解耦适配器 + register_tasks() API，支持任务在线到达/完成时的动态挂载，无需重建模型。作者给出隔离性与收敛一致性证明：时间交错的 hTask 在时间上天然隔离；空间批处理下 BaseOp 沿 batch 维拼接满足数学等价（[B1,B2]W = [B1W, B2W]，反向按任务独立算 loss 后批量回传），收敛偏差约 0.07 均方，且避免数值故障跨任务传播。

**2) 任务级：hTask 抽象与 DP 装箱**：同一 hTask 内任务空间批处理以提升利用率，不同 hTask 之间时间交织以隐藏停顿。任务按 token 数升序排序，序列按最长长度补齐；构建端到端延迟代价模型（BaseOp 延迟按分片数 N_g(s) 计算，Adapter 延迟以 u_a·t_a(n) 加权并以单 adapter 最大延迟为上界），流水线端到端延迟 L = 2·Σ_{s<S} L^(s) + 2C·max_s L^(s)（warm-up/drain + steady 阶段），并给出 1F1B 单阶段显存模型 M_stage = [M_b + ΣM_g]/S + ΣM_a(b_i, l_i) 用于 OOM 预判（与实测缩放一致）。以 bin-packing 形式用动态规划 F(m,n) 求解「M 个任务装入 N 个 hTask」的最小延迟方案，复杂度 O(M²(S+M))，并可并行加速 N 维；最小化延迟同时自动均衡各 hTask 负载。

**3) 算子级：两层解耦编排**。将 N 个 hTask 分组为 P 个 bucket：同 bucket 内 hTask 在同一流水线时钟内交错（intra-stage，DP/TP），不同 bucket 在不同时钟交错（inter-stage，PP）。分组通过最小化 bucket 间首阶段延迟方差（负载均衡）获得，并与 P 的遍历解耦。inter-stage：利用 PEFT 的「计算同质性」（bucket 内 micro-batch 形状一致、前后向耗时相同）剪枝调度空间，生成结构化 1F1B 流水线模板——按首阶段延迟降序排序 bucket、同一 bucket 的 micro-batch 连续、在显存允许下尽早发射尽可能多的 micro-batch（较基线提升 1.17×）；附录给出近最优性证明（Lemma 1–3、Theorem 1–2：steady 阶段主导端到端延迟，模板保证最后一级 stage 无内部气泡，隐藏最长 micro-batch 于中部反而变差）。intra-stage：把各 hTask 的 DAG 按「连续计算算子聚类 + 通信算子附加到其依赖算子」切分为子图，小规模 adapter 独立成子图，按拓扑深度赋优先级；扩展 Kahn 算法为多 DAG 的延迟感知调度（优先队列取累计延迟最长的零入度子图以最大化与在飞通信的重叠），产出 launch_schedule。**适配器水平融合与通信重叠**：跨任务 adapter 不可直接批处理，故做水平融合——同一 hTask 内空间批处理任务的 adapter 融合；同 bucket 内 hTask 若均只含单任务且不共享同一 AllReduce 子图也可融合（否则会引入全局同步）；跨 bucket 不融合。通信重叠中采用 NVLink SHARP 把归约卸载到 NVSwitch，仅用 8 个 CTA 即维持近峰值带宽并完全隐藏。

**4) 数据级：chunk-based 对齐**：为避免全局长度补零带来的跨任务无效 token（这些 token 由服务商承担、不能计费给用户），采用两步：先在任务内部自适应打包序列（保持收敛语义不变、保证 causal attention 的 KV 复用依赖），再把打包后的长序列均匀切分为等长 chunk（长序列按 chunk 顺序 scatter 并保留 KV cache 复用依赖），从而同时减少跨序列冗余 attention 计算、把超长序列切短以细化流水线、降低峰值激活显存。chunk 大小取所有序列长度的最大 2 的幂公约数并设下限（通常 64）以避免利用率过低。

**5) 实现**：基于 Megatron-LM + PyTorch，14K 行 Python + 2K 行 C++/CUDA；支持 GPipe/1F1B/interleaved-1F1B、Megatron TP、DP（DDP/FSDP）；通过 PyTorch hook 实现 Adapter 到 BaseOp 的动态挂载；基于 CUTLASS/CuTe 实现 grouped kernel（按各 adapter 的 FLOPs/访存比例分配线程块并做 tile 分解以均衡 SM 负载）；用 TorchFX 追踪为多任务 IR 图并做子图级编排，多 stream + CUDA Event 同步；离线 profiling 构建代价模型，调度开销控制在 10 秒内（典型微调任务 3–70 小时）。
AI.result: **端到端吞吐**（A40/H100，GPT3-2.7B/LLaMA2-7B/13B/OPT-30B，SST2/OpenBookQA/RTE 序列长 64/128/256）：Uniform 场景相对 HF-PEFT/NeMo/SL-PEFT 分别最高提升 2.33×/1.87×/1.64×；Non-uniform 场景为 2.23×/1.83×/1.85×（对 SL-PEFT 更高，因其大量补零浪费算力与显存）。H100 上更强：Uniform 相对 NeMo/SL-PEFT 提升 5.29×/2.31×，Non-uniform 提升 3.69×/1.94×——因 H100 算力更强反而放大单任务框架的利用率不足。**显存效率**（渐进提交 32 个任务、每轮 1 micro-batch）：2×A40 张量并行下相对 NeMo/HF-PEFT（15 任务后 OOM）与 SL-PEFT 最高降低 4.67×/1.44×；无显存约束扩到 32 任务时降低 5.29×/1.46×；更大 backbone（8×A40、LLaMA7B）下相对 NeMo/HF-PEFT（11 任务后 OOM）与 SL-PEFT 降低 3.57×/1.37×。原因是 backbone 只存一份（13.4GB vs 各基线每任务复制）且抑制跨任务无效 token 与细粒度流水线降低激活峰值。**消融**（LLaMA7B、4-GPU 流水线、全局 batch 128）：轻负载下关闭任务融合/算子编排/数据对齐分别使吞吐下降 36.1%/30.3%/22.5%；重负载下数据对齐成为主导（-34.3%），任务融合影响降至 -6.25%（GPU 已饱和），算子编排 -25.1%。**算子编排有效性**（Nsight 剖析，4-GPU TP 单层）：NeMo 单任务顺序发射算子，GPU 利用率 82.5%、层延迟 43.2ms；4 任务交错但不重叠时延迟线性增至 172.5ms 而利用率几乎不变（84.7%）；MuxTune 完全重叠后利用率 97.8%、延迟降至 156.2ms（相对基线 1.19×）。仅开启 backbone 共享+算子编排时，TP 下随任务数增加相对 NeMo 提升 1.20×/1.22×/1.23×，PP 下提升 1.24×/1.35×/1.36×（micro-batch 更少时可达 1.59×）。**数据对齐**（有效吞吐指标，剔除跨任务补零）：chunk=64 时相对 SL-PEFT 总体吞吐最高 2.33×、有效吞吐最高 3.59×；chunk=128（存在 chunk 内补零）时总体吞吐最高 3.77×、有效吞吐 2.57×。**扩展性与集群级**：Up-only 扩展相对 NeMo 吞吐 1.61×（次线性），Up-then-out 两者近线性、MuxTune 仍高 1.28×；基于一周 Philly trace 改造的 PEFT 负载在模拟 128-GPU 集群、FCFS 调度下，Uniform 场景集群吞吐相对 HF-PEFT/NeMo/SL-PEFT 提升 1.61×/1.51×/1.36×，Non-uniform 场景对 SL-PEFT 提升 1.58×。
AI.conclusion: MuxTune 通过「统一 PEFT 表示 + 层次化协同调度」把空间—时间骨干网复用落到可实现的系统设计中：任务级以 hTask 抽象与 DP 装箱在空间批处理与时间交错之间取得平衡，算子级以两层混合并行编排、适配器水平融合与 NVLink SHARP 通信重叠实现近乎无停顿的执行，数据级以 chunk-based 对齐抑制跨任务无效 token。相比单任务独占实例的基线，它同时改善了吞吐、显存与集群级资源效率，且具备任务隔离与收敛一致性保证，并支持任务在线到达的动态挂载。局限与后续方向：当前优化目标集中在实例级吞吐与显存，尚未把调度策略（如预算/优先级/SLO 感知）与「复用感知」的多路复用调度联合设计；未显式纳入能耗指标（可结合 admission control 与自适应频率调节）；流水线模板的近最优性依赖显存充足前提（实现中以代价模型做 OOM 延迟发射来兜底）；实验基于三类 PEFT、三种数据集与 A40/H100 平台，真实多租户轨迹与更大规模集群验证仍有空间。

title: ICSE 2023 Sustainability Report
summary: With growing discussions about the carbon footprint of academic conferences, more questions are being raised whether the environmental impacts caused by transportation and other factors justify the value of traditional paper presentations and social events. There is a pressing need to critically evaluate whether the ecological consequences of these events outweigh their perceived benefits. To that extent, we conducted a questionnaire survey among participants of the 45th International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE) 2023 in Melbourne, Australia, seeking their feedback on the different conference sessions (e.g., workshops, keynotes, paper presentations, social events). In total, 161 participants filled out our survey. Overall, the conference was rated with 4.4 stars out of 5 stars. We do not see any significant differences among the different sessions, making it difficult to derive conclusions about their certain value and implications to sustainability. The relatively low response rate (11%) did not help in gaining better insights. Based on the participants registration data, we additionally estimated the carbon footprint emerged from air travel. The total carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) accumulates to around 5,053.5 tonnes of CO2e which is equivalent to the electricity required to power around 1,000 homes in a year. With this report, we want to provide guidance to organizers of future conference editions with respect to their location and the perceived value of traditional paper presentations, social events, and other sessions.

AI.tldr: 研究通过问卷调查和数据分析评估2023年ICSE会议的碳足迹和参与者满意度，发现航空旅行产生约5053.5吨CO2e，但因响应率低难以得出各活动环节价值的明确结论。
AI.motivation: 随着学术界对会议碳足迹的讨论增加，需要评估交通等环境因素造成的生态影响是否超过传统论文演示和社交活动的益处。
AI.method: 对2023年ICSE会议参与者进行问卷调查(161人响应)，收集对不同会议环节的评价;同时根据参会者注册数据估算航空旅行产生的碳足迹。
AI.result: 会议总体评分4.4/5星，各环节间无显著差异；航空旅行碳足迹约5053.5吨CO2e，响应率仅11%。
AI.conclusion: 由于响应率较低(11%)，难以得出关于不同会议活动价值的明确结论。会议的航空旅行碳足迹约为5053.5吨CO2e，相当于约1000户家庭一年的用电量。研究为未来会议组织者提供了关于会议地点选择和传统会议活动价值的参考。

title: Estimating Visual Attribute Effects in Advertising from Observational Data: A Deepfake-Informed Double Machine Learning Approach
summary: Digital advertising increasingly relies on visual content, yet marketers lack rigorous methods for understanding how specific visual attributes causally affect consumer engagement. This paper addresses a fundamental methodological challenge: estimating causal effects when the treatment, such as a model's skin tone, is an attribute embedded within the image itself. Standard approaches like Double Machine Learning (DML) fail in this setting because vision encoders entangle treatment information with confounding variables, producing severely biased estimates. We develop DICE-DML (Deepfake-Informed Control Encoder for Double Machine Learning), a framework that leverages generative AI to disentangle treatment from confounders. The approach combines three mechanisms: (1) deepfake-generated image pairs that isolate treatment variation; (2) DICE-Diff adversarial learning on paired difference vectors, where background signals cancel to reveal pure treatment fingerprints; and (3) orthogonal projection that geometrically removes treatment-axis components. In simulations with known ground truth, DICE-DML reduces root mean squared error by 73-97% compared to standard DML, with the strongest improvement (97.5%) at the null effect point, demonstrating robust Type I error control. Applying DICE-DML to 232,089 Instagram influencer posts, we estimate the causal effect of skin tone on engagement. Standard DML produces diagnostically invalid results (negative outcome R^2), while DICE-DML achieves valid confounding control (R^2 = 0.63) and estimates a marginally significant negative effect of darker skin tone (-522 likes; p = 0.062), substantially smaller than the biased standard estimate. Our framework provides a principled approach for causal inference with visual data when treatments and confounders coexist within images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DICE-DML框架，解决视觉数据中因果推断的方法论挑战。通过结合deepfake图像对生成、对抗学习和正交投影技术，该方法在模拟中将估计误差降低73-97%，并在真实Instagram数据中实现有效的混杂控制，为视觉属性（如皮肤色调）对消费者参与度的因果效应估计提供了原则性方法。
AI.motivation: 数字广告越来越依赖视觉内容，但营销人员缺乏严格的方法来理解特定视觉属性如何因果影响消费者参与度。当处理变量（如模特的肤色）是嵌入图像本身的属性时，估计因果效应面临根本性的方法论挑战。标准方法如双重机器学习（DML）在这种设置下失败，因为视觉编码器将处理信息与混杂变量纠缠在一起，产生严重偏倚的估计。
AI.method: 开发了DICE-DML框架，利用生成式AI将处理变量与混杂变量分离。该方法结合了三种机制：（1）生成deepfake图像对以隔离处理变量变化；（2）DICE-Diff对抗学习，在配对差分向量上，背景信号相互抵消以揭示纯处理变量特征；（3）正交投影，从几何上移除处理轴分量。
AI.result: 在已知真实值的模拟中，DICE-DML将均方根误差降低73-97%，在零效应点改善最强（97.5%），显示出稳健的I类错误控制。将DICE-DML应用于232,089条Instagram网红帖子，估计肤色的因果效应。标准DML产生诊断无效的结果（负值结果R²），而DICE-DML实现有效的混杂控制（R²=0.63），并估计出略显著的深肤色负效应（-522点赞；p=0.062），显著小于偏倚的标准估计。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为处理变量和混杂变量共存于图像中时的视觉数据因果推断提供了原则性方法。

title: Virtual-Memory Assisted Buffer Management In Tiered Memory
summary: Tiered memory architectures have gained significant traction in the database community in recent years. In these architectures, the on-chip DRAM of the host processor is typically referred to as local memory, and forms the primary tier. Additional byte-addressable, cache-coherent memory resources, collectively referred to as remote memory (RMem, for short), form one or more secondary tiers. RMem is slower than local DRAM but faster than disk, e.g., NUMA memory located on a remote socket, chiplet-attached memory, and memory attached via high-performance interconnect protocols, e.g., RDMA and CXL. In this paper, we discuss how traditional two-tier (DRAM-Disk) virtual-memory assisted Buffer Management techniques generalize to an $n$-tier setting (DRAM-RMem-Disk). We present vmcache$^n$, an $n$-tier virtual-memory-assisted buffer pool that leverages the virtual memory subsystem and operating system calls to migrate pages across memory tiers. In this setup, page migration can become a bottleneck. To address this limitation, we introduce the move_pages2 system call that provides vmcache$^n$ with fine-grained control over the page migration process. Experiments show that vmcache$^n$ can achieve up to 4$\times$ higher query throughput over vmcache for TPC-C workloads.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了vmcache^n，一个支持n层内存（DRAM-RMem-Disk）的虚拟内存辅助缓冲池，利用操作系统页面迁移机制管理多层内存。实验表明vmcache^n在TPC-C工作负载下可实现比vmcache高4倍的查询吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 传统数据库缓冲管理采用两层架构（DRAM-Disk），但随着远程内存（RMem）等新型内存层级的出现，需要将两层虚拟内存辅助的缓冲管理技术扩展到n层架构，以充分利用不同层级的内存资源。
AI.method: 提出vmcache^n系统，利用虚拟内存子系统和操作系统调用实现页面在不同内存层级间的迁移。为解决页面迁移瓶颈，引入了move_pages2系统调用，提供细粒度的页面迁移控制能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，vmcache^n在TPC-C工作负载下可实现最高4倍于vmcache的查询吞吐量提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将传统两层内存管理扩展到n层内存架构，并利用move_pages2系统调用优化页面迁移过程，vmcache^n能够有效利用多层内存资源，显著提升数据库查询性能。

title: NExT-Guard: Training-Free Streaming Safeguard without Token-Level Labels
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in streaming scenarios, rendering conventional post-hoc safeguards ineffective as they fail to interdict unsafe content in real-time. While streaming safeguards based on token-level supervised training could address this, they necessitate expensive annotations and suffer from severe overfitting. In this work, we challenge the paradigm that streaming safety must rely on token-level supervised training. Instead, it is an inherent capability of well-trained post-hoc safeguards, as they already encode token-level risk signals in hidden representations. Hence, we introduce NExT-Guard, a training-free framework that achieves streaming safeguards by monitoring interpretable latent features from Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs). It uses pretrained SAEs from publicly available base LLMs, enabling flexible, low-cost deployment without token-level supervision. Experimental results show that NExT-Guard outperforms both post-hoc and streaming safeguards based on supervised training, with superior robustness across models, SAE variants, and risk scenarios. These results make NExT-Guard a universal and scalable paradigm for real-time safety, accelerating the practical deployment of streaming safeguards.

AI.tldr: 提出了NExT-Guard，一种无需训练的流式安全防护框架，通过监控稀疏自编码器(SAE)的可解释潜在特征实现实时不安全内容的拦截，解决了传统后验防护无法实时处理和监督学习标注成本高、易过拟合的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在流式场景中的部署日益增多，传统后验防护无法实时拦截不安全内容；现有的流式防护方法依赖Token级监督学习，需要昂贵的人工标注且存在严重过拟合问题。
AI.method: 提出NExT-Guard框架，核心观点是流式安全是后验防护的固有能力，因为后验防护已在隐藏表示中编码了Token级风险信号。该方法利用预训练的稀疏自编码器(SAE)监控可解释的潜在特征，无需Token级监督即可实现流式防护，具有低成本、灵活部署的特点。
AI.result: 实验表明，NExT-Guard在性能上优于基于监督学习的后验防护和流式防护方法，并在不同模型、SAE变体和风险场景下展现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: NExT-Guard是一种通用且可扩展的实时安全范式，能够加速流式防护的实际部署，为流式场景下的LLM安全提供了新的研究方向。

title: Scalable Mesh Coupling for Atmospheric Wave Simulation
comment: 5 pages, 6 figures, presented at SIAM International Meshing Roundtable 2026
summary: We describe the application of a scalable algorithm for interpolating solution data in the overlapping mesh region of two solvers. This feature is essential to obtain a globally consistent solution for in-situ coupled atmospheric wave simulation. We provide timings and discuss a real-world application run.

AI.tldr: 本文描述了一种可扩展算法，用于在两个求解器的重叠网格区域中插值求解数据，以实现大气波模拟的原地耦合。
AI.motivation: 在大气波模拟中，需要将两个求解器的解进行耦合，以获得全局一致的解。关键挑战在于如何在重叠网格区域高效、准确地插值求解数据。
AI.method: 采用可扩展的插值算法处理两个求解器重叠网格区域中的解数据耦合。
AI.result: 提供了算法的时间性能测试数据，并展示了实际应用案例的运行结果。
AI.conclusion: 该算法可有效实现大气波模拟的原地耦合计算，具有实用价值。

title: Reducing Labeling Effort in Architecture Technical Debt Detection through Active Learning and Explainable AI
comment: This manuscript is currently under review
summary: Self-Admitted Technical Debt (SATD) refers to technical compromises explicitly admitted by developers in natural language artifacts such as code comments, commit messages, and issue trackers. Among its types, Architecture Technical Debt (ATD) is particularly difficult to detect due to its abstract and context-dependent nature. Manual annotation of ATD is costly, time-consuming, and challenging to scale. This study focuses on reducing labeling effort in ATD detection by combining keyword-based filtering with active learning and explainable AI. We refined an existing dataset of 116 ATD-related Jira issues from prior work, producing 57 expert-validated items used to extract representative keywords. These were applied to identify over 103,000 candidate issues across ten open-source projects. To assess the reliability of this keyword-based filtering, we conducted a qualitative evaluation of a statistically representative sample of labeled issues. Building on this filtered dataset, we applied active learning with multiple query strategies to prioritize the most informative samples for annotation. Our results show that the Breaking Ties strategy consistently improves model performance, achieving the highest F1-score of 0.72 while reducing the annotation effort by 49\%. In order to enhance model transparency, we applied SHAP and LIME to explain the outcomes of automated ATD classification. Expert evaluation revealed that both LIME and SHAP provided reasonable explanations, with the usefulness of the explanations often depending on the relevance of the highlighted features. Notably, experts preferred LIME overall for its clarity and ease of use.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出结合关键词过滤、主动学习和可解释AI的方法来减少架构技术债务(ATD)检测中的标注工作量。在103,000个候选问题数据集上，Breaking Ties主动学习策略达到F1=0.72，减少49%标注工作量。SHAP和LIME解释方法中，专家更青睐LIME的清晰度。
AI.motivation: 架构技术债务(ATD)因其抽象性和上下文依赖性而难以检测，人工标注成本高、耗时长且难以扩展，需要一种方法来减少ATD检测中的标注工作量。
AI.method: 研究采用三阶段方法：(1) 从57个专家验证的ATD相关Jira问题中提取代表性关键词，用以筛选超过103,000个候选问题；(2) 应用多种查询策略的主动学习框架，优先标注最具信息量的样本；(3) 使用SHAP和LIME两种可解释AI方法对分类结果进行解释和评估。
AI.result: Breaking Ties策略表现最优，F1分数达到0.72，同时减少了49%的标注工作量。定性评估表明关键词过滤具有可靠性。SHAP和LIME都能提供合理的解释，但专家更偏好LIME的清晰度和易用性。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功地证明了结合关键词过滤、主动学习和可解释AI在减少ATD检测标注工作量方面的有效性。Breaking Ties策略在F1分数达到0.72的同时减少了49%的标注工作量。SHAP和LIME两种解释方法都能提供合理的模型解释，但专家更倾向于使用LIME，因其更清晰易用。

title: Can machines be uncertain?
summary: The paper investigates whether and how AI systems can realize states of uncertainty. By adopting a functionalist and behavioral perspective, it examines how symbolic, connectionist and hybrid architectures make room for uncertainty. The paper distinguishes between epistemic uncertainty, or uncertainty inherent in the data or information, and subjective uncertainty, or the system's own attitude of being uncertainty. It further distinguishes between distributed and discrete realizations of subjective uncertainty. A key contribution is the idea that some states of uncertainty are interrogative attitudes whose content is a question rather than a proposition.

AI.tldr: This paper examines how different AI architectures (symbolic, connectionist, hybrid) can realize states of uncertainty, distinguishing epistemic from subjective uncertainty and proposing that some uncertainty states are interrogative attitudes with question-based content rather than propositional content.
AI.motivation: Investigates whether and how AI systems can realize states of uncertainty, addressing a fundamental question about machine cognition and self-awareness.
AI.method: Adopts a functionalist and behavioral perspective to analyze how symbolic, connectionist, and hybrid architectures implement or accommodate uncertainty.
AI.result: Distinguishes between epistemic uncertainty (uncertainty in data/information) and subjective uncertainty (the system's own uncertainty attitude), further differentiating between distributed and discrete realizations of subjective uncertainty.
AI.conclusion: Some states of uncertainty in AI systems are interrogative attitudes whose content is a question rather than a proposition, representing a novel conceptualization of machine uncertainty.

title: Odin: Multi-Signal Graph Intelligence for Autonomous Discovery in Knowledge Graphs
summary: We present Odin, the first production-deployed graph intelligence engine for autonomous discovery of meaningful patterns in knowledge graphs without prior specification. Unlike retrieval-based systems that answer predefined queries, Odin guides exploration through the COMPASS (Composite Oriented Multi-signal Path Assessment) score, a novel metric that combines (1) structural importance via Personalized PageRank, (2) semantic plausibility through Neural Probabilistic Logic Learning (NPLL) used as a discriminative filter rather than generative model, (3) temporal relevance with configurable decay, and (4) community-aware guidance through GNN-identified bridge entities and inter-community affinity scores. This multi-signal integration, particularly the bridge scoring mechanism, addresses the "echo chamber" problem where graph exploration becomes trapped in dense local communities. We formalize the autonomous discovery problem, prove theoretical properties of our scoring function, and demonstrate that beam search with multi-signal guidance achieves $O(b \cdot h)$ complexity while maintaining high recall compared to exhaustive exploration. To our knowledge, Odin represents the first autonomous discovery system deployed in regulated production environments (healthcare and insurance), demonstrating significant improvements in pattern discovery quality and analyst efficiency. Our approach maintains complete provenance traceability -- a critical requirement for regulated industries where hallucination is unacceptable.

AI.tldr: Odin是首个生产部署的图智能引擎，通过COMPASS多信号评分(结构重要性、语义合理性、时序相关性、社区感知)实现知识图谱中无先验知识的自主模式发现，解决了图探索的回音室问题，在医疗和保险行业部署并保持完整溯源。
AI.motivation: 解决知识图谱中自主发现问题的问题。现有检索系统只能回答预定义查询，无法自主探索发现有意义模式。同时，图探索容易陷入"回音室"问题——困在密集的局部社区中无法发现跨社区的重要模式。需要在无先验知识的情况下引导图探索发现潜在模式。
AI.method: 提出COMPASS评分函数，整合四个信号：(1)基于Personalized PageRank的结构重要性；(2)使用Neural Probabilistic Logic Learning (NPLL)作为判别过滤器而非生成模型的语义合理性；(3)带可配置衰减的时序相关性；(4)通过GNN识别的桥接实体和社区间亲和度得分实现社区感知引导。采用束搜索(beam search)进行多信号引导的探索。
AI.result: 理论上证明了评分函数的理论属性；束搜索在保持高召回率的同时达到O(b·h)的复杂度；部署于医疗和保险受监管生产环境，显著提升模式发现质量和分析师效率。
AI.conclusion: Odin是首个在受监管生产环境中部署的自主发现系统，解决了图探索的回音室问题，通过多信号集成和桥接评分机制实现跨社区模式发现，同时满足受监管行业的完整溯源追踪要求。

title: Forecasting as Rendering: A 2D Gaussian Splatting Framework for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting (TSF) remains a challenging problem due to the intricate entanglement of intraperiod-fluctuations and interperiod-trends. While recent advances have attempted to reshape 1D sequences into 2D period-phase representations, they suffer from two principal limitations.Firstly, treating reshaped tensors as static images results in a topological mismatch, as standard spatial operators sever chronological continuity at grid boundaries. Secondly, relying on uniform fixed-size representations allocates modeling capacity inefficiently and fails to provide the adaptive resolution required for compressible, non-stationary temporal patterns. To address these limitations, we introduce TimeGS, a novel framework that fundamentally shifts the forecasting paradigm from regression to 2D generative rendering. By reconceptualizing the future sequence as a continuous latent surface, TimeGS utilizes the inherent anisotropy of Gaussian kernels to adaptively model complex variations with flexible geometric alignment. To realize this, we introduce a Multi-Basis Gaussian Kernel Generation (MB-GKG) block that synthesizes kernels from a fixed dictionary to stabilize optimization, and a Multi-Period Chronologically Continuous Rasterization (MP-CCR) block that enforces strict temporal continuity across periodic boundaries. Comprehensive experiments on standard benchmark datasets demonstrate that TimeGS attains state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: TimeGS通过将时间序列预测重新定义为2D生成渲染问题，利用多基高斯核和连续光栅化技术解决传统方法中拓扑不匹配和时间连续性缺失的问题，在基准数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测（TSF）面临挑战，原因在于周期内波动与周期间趋势的复杂交织。现有的2D period-phase表示方法存在两大缺陷：1）将重塑的张量视为静态图像导致拓扑不匹配，标准空间算子在网格边界处破坏了时间连续性；2）均匀固定大小的表示方法建模效率低下，无法为可压缩的非平稳时间模式提供自适应分辨率。
AI.method: 提出TimeGS框架，将预测范式从回归转变为2D生成渲染。核心包括：1）多基高斯核生成（MB-GKG）块：从固定字典合成核以稳定优化；2）多周期时间连续光栅化（MP-CCR）块：强制执行跨周期边界的时间连续性。将未来序列重构为连续潜表面，利用高斯核的固有各向异性进行自适应建模。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: TimeGS通过创新的2D生成渲染范式，成功解决了时间序列预测中周期内波动与周期间趋势纠缠的难题，为时序预测领域提供了新的研究方向。

title: Dynamic Contract Analysis for Parallel Programming Models
comment: A peer-reviewed version is to be published by IEEE as part of the IPDPS HIPS workshop proceedings. This is the originally submitted article
summary: Parallel programming in high-performance computing depends on low-level APIs such as MPI, requiring users to manage synchronization and resources manually. Several correctness checking tools exist to help bug-free code development, though most target a single programming model, limiting their applicability. Our previous work, the static analysis tool CoVer, leverages a contract-based approach enabling users to specify custom error-checking rules and support emerging or unconventional programming models without requiring extensive new tooling. However, static analysis cannot fully reason about runtime-dependent behavior such as pointer aliasing or indirect control flow. To address this, we present CoVer-Dynamic, a dynamic analysis extension that reuses CoVer's contract language to provide a unified static-dynamic verification framework. By enforcing the same contracts at runtime, CoVer-Dynamic improves classification accuracy and eliminates false positives on standardized MPI and OpenSHMEM benchmarks, while detecting errors beyond static analysis only. Our evaluation shows that CoVer-Dynamic consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art correctness checker MUST, averaging a 2x speedup. Finally, our results show limitations in the expressiveness of the contract language, motivating future work to support more error classes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoVer-Dynamic作为CoVer的动态分析扩展，通过重用契约语言实现统一的静态-动态验证框架，解决静态分析无法处理运行时依赖行为的问题，在MPI和OpenSHMEM基准测试中表现优于MUST工具，平均加速2倍
AI.motivation: 静态分析无法完全推理运行时依赖行为（如指针别名或间接控制流），需要动态分析补充；同时现有正确性检查工具仅针对单一编程模型，限制了其适用性
AI.method: 提出CoVer-Dynamic动态分析扩展，重用CoVer的契约语言，在运行时强制执行相同的契约检查规则，实现静态-动态联合验证
AI.result: CoVer-Dynamic在标准化MPI和OpenSHMEM基准测试中消除了假阳性，提高了分类准确性，检测到仅静态分析无法发现的错误；平均比MUST快2倍
AI.conclusion: CoVer-Dynamic成功实现了统一的静态-动态验证框架，通过在运行时强制执行相同的契约，提高了分类准确性并消除了标准化MPI和OpenSHMEM基准测试中的假阳性。该工具平均比MUST快2倍，但当前契约语言的表达能力存在局限，需要进一步扩展以支持更多错误类别。

title: EvoSkill: Automated Skill Discovery for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Coding agents are increasingly used as general-purpose problem solvers, but their flexibility does not by itself confer the domain expertise needed for specialized tasks. Recent work addresses this through \textit{agent skills}: reusable workflows, and code, that augment agents with domain-specific capabilities.
